remarks: Welcome to the most charming and serene neighborhood to call yours!!! Discover the warmth of this quiet and peaceful tree lined street. This inviting 3 bedroom and 2 and half bath home offers a comfortable, manageable footprint with space to make it your own. A patio provides a welcoming spot for morning coffee, outdoor dining, or unwinding at the end of the day. Whether you're purchasing your first home or looking to simplify, this charming residence is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy Laguna Niguel living. Close to shopping, dining and award-winning schools! Come and explore its allure and envision the possibilities today!
